summary: Fix concurrent add() race condition using file lock (fcntl.flock) for atomic read-modify-write
approach: Added _exclusive_lock() context manager to TodoStorage using fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX). Wrapped all read-modify-write operations in cli.py (add, mark_done, mark_undone, remove) with the lock to ensure mutual exclusion across processes.
risks: fcntl is Unix-specific; not portable to Windows (would need msvcrt.locking or portalocker for cross-platform)
Lock file (.todo.json.lock) may be orphaned if process is killed while holding lock
limitations: Only protects read-modify-write in TodoApp methods; direct TodoStorage.save() calls are not protected
